_comment: Per-role MCP surface budgets over the canonical builtin and discovery definitions (ORB-21263). role_surface_budget fails when a role's tools or approximate tokens exceed its budget. Raising a budget is a reviewed decision: say in the PR why the role needs the extra surface. The resident role needs orbit.resident.metrics to inspect read-only mandate history, and orbit.evolution.add/list/show to record and read cost events; operator and manager include the resident toolset. The read-only orbit.resident.digest adds one tool to those three roles. The read-only orbit.attention task-level feed belongs to tasks-read, shared by every role and the default surface (ORB-21168). Its filter and cursor schema requires token budget increases in all six surfaces; only operator, manager and resident need an extra tool slot. Federation (ORB-21171) adds host_unhealthy, one sentence on the federated fan-out and the reserved candidate_read input the mux checks against each destination's live schema: about 70 tokens on every surface, with no new tool. Runtime kinds (ORB-21169) name run_failed, run_stuck and claim_stale in the attention description: about 70 tokens on every surface, with no new tool; operator and manager crossed their ceilings. Manager channel (ORB-21245) adds orbit.resident.control and orbit.resident.relay to the resident toolset: two extra tools on operator, manager and resident (about 1130-1200 tokens there) and names resident_stalled in the attention description (about 120 tokens on every surface, so all six ceilings move). Measured totals are default 41/~23823, operator 85/~42812, manager 29/~14809, resident 38/~23965, agent 32/~19342 and reader 14/~7732; token ceilings round these totals up to the next hundred. ORB-21619's corrected orbit.resident.relay output description (comment and answer, not a comment id) adds about 16 tokens on the surfaces carrying it; operator and manager cross their ceilings, so theirs rise by a hundred. `orbit tool list --role <role>` reports the current size. ORB-21170 names ci_red and friction_untriaged in the attention description plus provider/proxy sentences (about 304 bytes / ~76 tokens on every surface, with no new tool); resident, agent and reader cross their ceilings, so theirs rise to 24100, 19500 and 7900 (measured resident 38/~24041, agent 32/~19418, reader 14/~7808). That update did not raise operator or manager, which the same 76 tokens also pushed over: measured operator 85/~42915 and manager 29/~14911 round up to 43000 and 15000. The increase is the ci_red and friction_untriaged attention text, which every surface carries; no tool was added (ORB-21691).
